definitions.explanation: temporarily forgetting something you normally know well, often at an inconvenient moment

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ど{忘|わす}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a mental blank on the name.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ど{忘|わす}れ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I completely blanked on my password and was stuck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ど{忘|わす}れ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{書|か}けなかった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I had a mental block and couldn't write the kanji.

notes:
FORMS:
ど (intensive prefix) + ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (forgetting) → complete momentary forgetting
ど{忘|わす}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a mental blank)

CHARACTERISTICS:
- Temporary - the memory usually returns
- Often happens under pressure or when trying to recall on the spot
- Common with names, kanji, passwords, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物忘|ものわす}れ→物忘れ：17610_monowasure⟧ - general forgetfulness (trait)
- ど{忘|わす}れ - momentary blank (specific instance)
- ⟦うっかり{忘|わす}れ→うっかり忘れ：08977_ukkariwasure⟧ - careless forgetting (due to inattention)
